caseName: General Tire & Rubber Co. v. Watkins
caseNameFull: General Tire & Rubber Co. v. Watkins, U. S. District Judge
attorneys: Norman P. Ramsey and Charles J. Merriam for petitioner., Solicitor General Cox filed a memorandum for the United States. Edward S. Irons, William Wade Beckett and Stanley M. Clark for Firestone Tire & Rubber Co. et al., as amici curiae, in opposition.

opinions.text: Motion of Firestone Tire & Rubber Co. et al. for leave to file brief, as amici curiae, granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit denied.
